name: toppa
description: Michael Toppa's curated Claude Code plugins: guidance for Rails, Inertia, and React work, the workflow around the code, a documentation pattern for a project, and a writing style.

plugins.name: rails-core
plugins.description: Rails and Ruby guidance for every Rails project: extraction thresholds, architecture boundaries, Rails 8.1 idioms, Postgres patterns, security review, RSpec conventions, and test performance.

plugins.name: inertia-react
plugins.description: Inertia Rails and React guidance for projects that pair a Rails back end with a React front end over Inertia.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: The workflow around the code, in any language: writing an issue for the team's tracker, implementing an issue against its acceptance criteria, writing a plan document, working it step by step, splitting a change into reviewable commits, writing the message for each one, writing the pull request title and body, reviewing a pull request or the queue of pull requests that await the user's review, and triaging the Sentry review queue.

plugins.name: standing-documents
plugins.description: The standing-documents guide, which gives each kind of project documentation one home, and the adopt skill, which applies the guide to a project or upgrades it to a newer version.

plugins.name: ste-writing
plugins.description: The ASD-STE100 output style, a house style that draws on Simplified Technical English. It sets the shape of each English sentence that Claude writes: replies, documents, commit messages, pull request text, and code comments.
